definitions.bigram: Script 4 Euclidean distance between complete-alphabet bigram frequencies, denominator count + 1e-3
definitions.local_alignment: Script 3 figure method: Smith-Waterman 2/-1/-1; divide each sequence-pair score by log(combined sequence length); average every sequence pair; convert similarity to distance using the global maximum. Script 4 uses this exact saved matrix.
definitions.repeat_A: Script 4 Euclidean distance between Phee-run probabilities for lengths 2-5, denominator count + 1e-3
definitions.transition_probability: Script 4 Euclidean distance between flattened row-normalized transition matrices
